gloss: highest rank; top position; uppermost level

definitions.gloss: highest rank; top position; uppermost level
definitions.explanation: The very top of a hierarchy, ranking, or classification system.

examples.japanese: {最上位|さいじょうい}のモデルを{選|えら}んだ。
{売上|うりあげ}ランキングで{最上位|さいじょうい}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: It made it to the top of the sales ranking.

examples.japanese: この{資格|しかく}は{業界|ぎょうかい}で{最上位|さいじょうい}に{位置|いち}づけられており、{取得|しゅとく}には{数年|すうねん}の{実務|じつむ}{経験|けいけん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: This qualification is ranked at the highest level in the industry, and requires several years of practical experience to obtain.

notes:
Composed of {最|さい} (most, highest) + {上位|じょうい} (upper rank). Used to describe the very top of a hierarchy, whether in product lines, rankings, organizational structures, or classification systems.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最上位|さいじょうい}モデル — top-end model
- {最上位|さいじょうい}に{位置|いち}する — be positioned at the top
- {最上位|さいじょうい}の{資格|しかく} — highest-level qualification
- {最上位|さいじょうい}{機種|きしゅ} — top-of-the-line model

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最高位|さいこうい} — highest rank; virtually synonymous but slightly more formal and often used for official titles and ceremonial ranks
- {上位|じょうい} — upper rank, higher position; less extreme than {最上位|さいじょうい}, which is specifically the very top
- トップ — top; the casual loanword equivalent, used broadly in everyday speech
